meta.name: prisma-compute
meta.description: Prisma Compute deployment and hosting guide. Use whenever the user mentions Prisma Compute, `prisma.compute.ts`, `defineComputeConfig`, deploying or hosting a Prisma app, `@prisma/cli app deploy`, `compute:deploy`, `create-prisma --deploy`, `PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN`, Compute auth/workspaces, apps/deployments/build logs/domains, localhost vs `0.0.0.0`, deploy port binding, or framework deploy readiness for Hono, Elysia, Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, Nuxt, Svelte, Nest, Turborepo, or custom/prebuilt artifacts.

copy.tagline: 部署 Prisma 后端服务到托管平台,理顺端口、域名与构建日志。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把 Prisma 应用发布到托管平台,想搞定端口、域名和构建日志。
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Prisma apps to managed hosting: handle domains, ports, and build logs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you deploy Prisma apps and need help setting up ports, domains, and build logs.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你把 TypeScript 应用部署到 Prisma Compute:先检查项目的 prisma.compute.ts 与生成的部署脚本,再用 @prisma/cli 执行部署,处理工作区认证与端口绑定,查看构建/运行日志并排查报错。
howto.when: 当你提到 Prisma Compute、部署或托管应用、compute:deploy 等关键词,或问到部署配置、认证、日志时触发。

say.text: 看看这次部署的构建日志,失败在哪一步

howto.what_en: Claude guides deploying your TypeScript app to Prisma Compute: it checks prisma.compute.ts and generated scripts, runs @prisma/cli deploy commands, handles workspace auth, reads build and runtime logs, and troubleshoots failures.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention Prisma Compute, deploying or hosting an app, or compute:deploy, or ask about deploy config, auth, or logs.
